title: Encode and Decode Strings
prompt: Design an algorithm to encode a list of strings to a string and decode a string to a list of strings. Implement the encode and decode methods. You are not allowed to solve the problem using any serialize methods (such as eval).
constraints: strs[i] contains any possible characters out of 256 valid ASCII characters.
hints: You need a way to delimit strings. Use length prefix: encode as "4#word4#word" so you know where each string ends.
Format: length + '#' + string. To decode, read the number before '#', then read that many chars.
Handle empty strings: "0#" for empty string.
This approach handles any character including '#' in the string since we use length.
